nodes.name: toIcalDate
nodes.summary: Private helper: converts ISO date string to iCalendar format (compact UTC without timezone offset)

nodes.name: escapeIcal
nodes.summary: Private helper: escapes special characters in iCalendar format (backslash, comma, semicolon, newline)

nodes.name: buildGoogleCalendarUrl
nodes.summary: Builds a Google Calendar render URL for creating a quick event from the workshop site
nodes.signature: (params: { title: string; startIso: string; endIso: string; location?: string; description?: string }): string

nodes.name: buildIcalString
nodes.summary: Builds an iCalendar (RFC 5545) formatted string for email attachments or downloads; supports both METHOD:PUBLISH (standalone) and METHOD:REQUEST (with organizer/attendee)
nodes.signature: (params: { uid: string; title: string; startIso: string; endIso: string; location?: string; description?: string; organizer?: { name: string; email: string }; attendee?: { name: string; email: string }; sequence?: number }): string

nodes.name: buildEventCalendarDescription
nodes.summary: Builds the canonical calendar event description from event data; stays in sync with page content instead of drifting into stale hand-written copy
nodes.signature: (event: { title: string; summary: string; slug: string; zoomLink?: string; durationLabel?: string }): string

nodes.name: CalendarInviteResult
nodes.summary: Union type for calendar invite operation outcomes: invited, already-invited, skipped (with reason), or failed (with reason)
nodes.signature: { status: 'invited' } | { status: 'already-invited' } | { status: 'skipped'; reason: string } | { status: 'failed'; reason: string }

nodes.name: CALENDAR_ID
nodes.summary: Google Calendar ID from environment or defaults to 'primary'

nodes.name: resolveCalendarEventId
nodes.summary: Resolves the Google Calendar event ID for an event; checks env vars first (GOOGLE_CALENDAR_EVENT_ID_<SLUG>), then event.calendarEvent, then fallback

nodes.name: getAuth
nodes.summary: Private helper: retrieves Google OAuth2 authentication from environment variables (clientId, clientSecret, refreshToken)

nodes.name: inviteAttendeeToEvent
nodes.summary: Adds a registrant to the event's Google Calendar entry; best-effort design (calendar failures never fail registration); validates event start date matches page, enforces guest privacy (guests cannot see other guests)
nodes.signature: (event: EventDefinition, attendeeEmail: string, attendeeName?: string): Promise<CalendarInviteResult>

nodes.name: START, END, UID
nodes.summary: Test fixtures for calendar tests: START/END timestamps and unique identifier

nodes.name: buildGoogleCalendarUrl tests
nodes.summary: Test suite: 8 tests covering URL generation (base URL, action param, title encoding, dates format, location, description)

nodes.name: buildIcalString tests
nodes.summary: Test suite: 13 tests covering iCalendar generation (VCALENDAR/VEVENT wrappers, METHOD:PUBLISH vs REQUEST, UID, SEQUENCE, special char escaping, organizer, attendee, timestamps, CRLF line endings, update semantics)
